papers.title_en: The Biomechanical Influence of Step Width on Typical Locomotor Activities: A Systematic Review
papers.title_zh: 步宽对典型运动活动生物力学的影响：一项系统综述
papers.abstract_en: Step width is a spatial variable in the frontal plane, defined as the mediolateral distance between the heel (forefoot during sprinting) of bilateral feet at initial contact. Variations in step width may impact the lower limb biomechanics. This systematic review aimed to synthesize the published findings to determine the influence of acute changes in step width on locomotion biomechanics and provide implications for injury prevention and enhanced sports performance. Literature was identified, selected, and appraised in accordance with the methods of a systematic review. Four electronic databases (Web of Science, MEDLINE via PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect) were searched up until May 2023 with the development of inclusion criteria based on the PICO model. papers.title_en: Investigating the Impact of Preoperative Kinesiophobia and Pain on Postoperative Gait Biomechanics Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury
papers.title_zh: 探究术前运动恐惧症和疼痛对前交叉韧带损伤术后步态生物力学的影响
papers.abstract_en: Background: Aberrant gait biomechanics—ie, lower knee abduction moment (KAM) impulse— are linked to the development of posttraumatic osteoarthritis after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury and ACL reconstruction (ACLR). There is a clinical need to identify modifiable factors, such as kinesiophobia and pain, that may contribute to aberrant gait development after ACLR to advance multimodal rehabilitation strategies. Purpose/Hypothesis: This study aimed to determine associations between preoperative kinesiophobia and pain and gait biomechanics linked to posttraumatic osteoarthritis development at 2 and 4 months after ACLR. We hypothesized that worse preoperative kinesiophobia and pain would be associated with lower KAM impulses in the ACLR limb but not the uninjured limb at 2 and 4 months after ACLR. papers.title_en: Lower Extremity Mechanical Energetics During Walking 6 Months Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: 前交叉韧带重建术后6个月步行期间的下肢机械能学
papers.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports
papers.abstract_en: Aberrant gait biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury and ACL reconstruction (ACLR) are critical factors contributing to the development of knee osteoarthritis (KOA). However, it remains unknown how ACLR impacts lower extremity joint energetics and each joint's contribution to total limb energetics during walking. To compare mechanical energetics at the ankle, knee, and hip joints between ACLR limbs, contralateral, and control limbs during walking. Forty‐four participants with primary unilateral ACLR (post‐ACLR: 6.0 ± 0.2 months) and 44 uninjured controls were studied. Ankle, knee, and hip joint work were calculated as the time integral of the negative (energy dissipation) or positive (energy generation) regions of the respective stance‐phase joint power curves. papers.title_en: Classifying Impact Loading Using Axial Peak Tibial Acceleration and Impact‐Related Biomechanical Differences During Treadmill Running
papers.title_zh: 基于轴向胫骨峰值加速度和冲击相关生物力学差异的跑步机跑步冲击载荷分类
papers.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports
papers.abstract_en: Measuring lower extremity impact acceleration is a common strategy to identify runners with increased injury risk. However, existing axial peak tibial acceleration (PTA) thresholds for determining high‐impact runners typically rely on small samples or fixed running speeds. This study aimed to describe the distribution of axial PTA among runners at their preferred running speed, determine an appropriate adjustment for investigating impact magnitude at different speeds, and compare biomechanics between runners classified by impact magnitude. A total of 171 runners ran on an instrumented treadmill at their preferred running speed during 3D motion capture. Axial PTA was collected at the distal tibia. papers.abstract_zh: 测量下肢冲击加速度是识别损伤风险较高跑者的常见策略。然而，现有的用于确定高冲击跑者的轴向胫骨峰值加速度（PTA）阈值通常依赖于小样本或固定跑步速度。本研究旨在描述跑者在其习惯跑步速度下的轴向PTA分布，确定研究不同速度下冲击大小的适当调整方法，并比较按冲击大小分类的跑者之间的生物力学差异。共有171名跑者在仪器化跑步机上跑步。

papers.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports
papers.abstract_en: In 2021, the journal introduced a new “SJMSS Paper of the Year” award. This is decided by a panel comprising the Senior Section Editors of the journal and is awarded to a paper published in the calendar year 2022. The paper is selected on the basis of that which provides new and important insights in the field of sport and exercise science and medicine, coupled with a high level of scientific rigor. The recipient of the 2022 SJMSS Paper of the Year is Kujala et al.1 for their paper entitled: “Physical activity and health: Findings from Finnish monozygotic twin pairs discordant for physical activity.” This paper, which is a hybrid of a review and an original research paper, has investigated indices of health from monozygotic twin pairs extracted from two established Finnish twin cohorts. papers.abstract_zh: 2021年，该期刊设立了新的“SJMSS 年度论文”奖。该奖项由期刊高级版块编辑组成的评审团决定，并授予在2022日历年发表的论文。论文的评选标准是其在运动与锻炼科学和医学领域提供了新的重要见解，并兼具高水平的科学严谨性。2022年度SJMSS论文的获奖者是Kujala等人的论文1，题为：“体育活动与健康：芬兰单卵双生子身体活动不一致研究的发现”。
